name: Polymarket BTC pair-cost state
description: From the bound Polymarket market's two native outcome asks, pair_cost = up_ask + down_ask - 1 is the cost of locking a one-dollar payout across both outcome tokens (negative is gross locked profit). fee_adjusted_pair_cost adds the per-share taker fee on both legs, computed with the fee authority's rate-times-probability-product formula fee = rate * ask * (1 - ask) per contract and its rounding, mirrored from the repo fee authority. state is locked_profit when fee_adjusted_pair_cost is negative, premium when it exceeds premium_threshold, and fair otherwise. A missing outcome ask is a defined not-ready state. Polymarket only. fee_rate defaults to 0.07, fee_rounding defaults to ceil_cent, and premium_threshold defaults to 0.01. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
